newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: SOCCER-NEESKENS BECOMES DUTCH ASSISTANT COACH.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-NEESKENS BECOMES DUTCH ASSISTANT COACH.

text.p: Johan Neeskens has been appointed assistant coach to the Dutch national team, it was announced on Tuesday.
Neeskens, who played for the Netherlands in the 1974 and 1978 World Cup finals, takes up his new post helping Guus Hiddink ahead of Saturday's World Cup qualifier against Wales in Cardiff.
The former Ajax and Barcelona midfielder, who has recently been working with Germany's FC Singen, has signed a two-year contract with the Dutch soccer association (KNVB).
Neeskens, currently living in Switzerland, will also head the KNVB's youth programme.
